summary: Close to implementable: layout, effects and failure classes are specified, but collection membership canonicalisation (where orderedness is declared, how unsorted indexes are treated and which collation 'sorted by ID' uses) is undefined.

questions.text: Where is a collection declared ordered or unordered?
questions.reason: RootStore must read the membership policy from the contract; the ADR only says ordered collections preserve order and unordered ones use deterministic ID order.

questions.text: For an unordered collection, does materialization sort the guest list, and does reading reject an unsorted index.dhall?
questions.reason: Decides whether materialization changes the value and whether hand-edited indexes load; ADR says both 'Membership preserves the guest list order' and 'For unordered collections the list is sorted by ID'.

questions.text: What comparator defines 'sorted by ID' (code point, UTF-8 bytes, Text Ord or encoded filename)?
questions.reason: Fixes committed index.dhall bytes and reopen stability; ADR only says 'deterministic ID order' and that file trees 'canonicalize entry order'.

questions.text: What happens when an ID's ~hex-escaped filename exceeds filesystem or Git component length limits?
questions.reason: Escaping doubles length, so long non-ASCII IDs can break checkout; ADR defines the escape but no limit, rejection or fallback.

questions.text: Where do recipe definitions and state come from when MaterializeRoot builds a Root?
questions.reason: Changes the effect signature and candidate round-trip; the input is 'KnowledgeBase CheckedValue' and code may not overlap recipe material, but the ADR never says the KnowledgeBase wrapper carries recipes.

questions.text: On ordinary loading, is an absent facts/ directory or a missing root.dhall or collection index.dhall a diagnostic or an empty value?
questions.reason: Sets the loader's failure rules and what scaffolding must emit; ADR rejects 'missing/unlisted files' and distinguishes empty from missing, but LoadRootMaterialAt treats an absent facts directory as empty.

questions.text: Is an empty FactId, collection name or example name valid?
questions.reason: Affects validation and the path codec; pass-through is defined only for nonempty names, so an empty name would encode as a bare '~', but its validity is never stated.

questions.text: What happens to entries under facts/ that belong to no declared collection (dropped collections, nested directories, non-.dhall files)?
questions.reason: Decides reader strictness and whether removing a collection must delete its directory; ADR rejects unlisted files only within a collection.

questions.text: Does the ~hex escape also apply to collection directory names, so camelCase field names become hex directories?
questions.reason: Determines persisted directory paths and routing collision checks; the escape rule speaks of 'names' and IDs without saying whether collection names are covered or case-mapped.

questions.text: What marks a root field as a collection rather than a field stored in facts/root.dhall?
questions.reason: Drives the split of the root value into files; ADR says routing belongs to the root contract/store but not what the contract must carry to mark a collection.

questions.text: What is the exact Dhall shape of facts/<collection>/index.dhall?
questions.reason: Persisted kernel-owned structure passed to DhallHandling as a Shape; ADR says only 'an explicit ordered ID list per collection'.

questions.text: Does RootStore check root/plugins/config/<plugin>.dhall against connector contracts at materialization, or carry it as raw bytes until PrepareRoot?
questions.reason: Ownership of config checking; ADR says RootStore persists config 'checked against' connector schemas, yet MaterializeRoot receives no connector contracts and opening carries config as bytes.

questions.text: How does ReadExamples represent an example whose fingerprint no longer matches or whose query no longer exists?
questions.reason: Shapes the Example type and checker interface; ADR says it must not decode mismatches and that checking reports incompatibility, but not what is returned.

questions.text: What fields does example.dhall hold beyond the original name?
questions.reason: Persisted metadata format; ADR says it retains the original name and recorded fingerprints are compared, without a full schema.

questions.text: Must a 'data-only' fact file be a normal-form literal, or may it be any import-free expression that normalizes to data?
questions.reason: Changes what DhallHandling accepts and the parse cost measured; ADR says 'data-only' and rejects imports 'before normalization', implying normalization but not what is allowed.
